title: SciLitBench: Benchmark and Design Principles for LLM-Powered Systematic Literature Reviews
abstract: arXiv:2609.05505v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Systematic reviews require sustained human judgment across thousands of records, yet existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) typically examine review stages in isolation. We introduce SciLitBench, a multi-stage benchmark spanning title and abstract screening, full-text screening, and schema-guided data extraction, with 42,981 retrieved records, 1,012 full texts, and annotations for 888 included papers. Across 22 open-weight LLMs from six model families, explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria improve title and abstract screening $F_2$ by 28.8\%, while researcher-authored rationales improve full-text screening by 15\%. Data extraction reveals a different reliability regime: performance declines from 0.97 accuracy for publication year to 0.37 Jaccard overlap for computational approach, while the strongest models recover only 30\% of annotated evaluation evidence and 25\% of limitations. translated_title: SciLitBench：面向大语言模型驱动的系统性文献综述的基准测试与设计原则
translated_abstract: 系统性文献综述需要对数千条记录进行持续的人工判断，然而现有对大语言模型（LLM）的评估通常只是孤立地考察综述的各个阶段。我们提出了SciLitBench，这是一个多阶段基准，涵盖标题与摘要筛选、全文筛选以及基于模式（schema）引导的数据抽取，包含42,981条检索记录、1,012篇全文以及888篇入选论文的标注。在来自六个模型家族的22个开放权重LLM上，明确的纳入与排除标准使标题与摘要筛选的F2分数提升了28.8%，而由研究者撰写的理由说明使全文筛选性能提升了15%。数据抽取则呈现出截然不同的可靠性状况：性能从出版年份0.97的准确率下降至计算方法仅0.37的Jaccard重叠度，而且即使是最强的模型也只能恢复30%的标注评估证据和25%的局限性内容。SciLitBench识别出了一个实用的（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了首个覆盖标题摘要筛选、全文筛选和数据抽取全流程的系统性文献综述多阶段基准SciLitBench，发现明确的筛选标准与研究者撰写的理由说明能显著提升LLM的筛选性能，但LLM在细粒度数据抽取上仍远不可靠，最强模型也仅能恢复30%的评估证据。
en_tdlr: We introduce SciLitBench, a multi-stage benchmark for LLM-powered systematic literature reviews, showing that explicit criteria and researcher-authored rationales substantially improve screening performance, while even the strongest models recover only 30% of annotated evaluation evidence in schema-guided data extraction.
